shared_elements: human figures shown frontally/in profile with elaborate headgear
blocks of script-like signs above/beside figures
figures with raised arms holding objects
rectangular field of sign-glyphs organized in rows or columns
justification: Both surfaces are upright carved slabs showing standing human figures in shallow relief accompanied by a block of script-like signs placed above/beside them, with the figures gesturing and holding objects—a genuinely comparable scheme of 'figures plus a caption of glyphs'. But the treatment differs strongly: A shows several slim, sparsely outlined figures in strict profile in an open, uncluttered register, while B shows a single massive frontal figure in dense, deeply modelled ornament that fills the whole field, so the specific forms and proportions do not correspond.
